import bpy, math, mathutils
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# ---- Clear scene ----
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
for coll in (bpy.data.meshes, bpy.data.cameras, bpy.data.lights):
    for x in list(coll):
        coll.remove(x)
for m in list(bpy.data.materials):
    bpy.data.materials.remove(m)

# ---- Materials ----
def make_mat(name, rgb, rough=0.7, metal=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name); mat.use_nodes=True
    bsdf = next(n for n in mat.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='BSDF_PRINCIPLED')
    bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (rgb[0],rgb[1],rgb[2],1.0)
    bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = rough
    bsdf.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metal
    return mat

make_mat('m_desk_top',  (0.55,0.56,0.58))
make_mat('m_desk_dark', (0.28,0.29,0.31))
make_mat('m_monitor',   (0.16,0.17,0.19))
make_mat('m_chair',     (0.72,0.16,0.16))
make_mat('m_sofa',      (0.74,0.76,0.79))
make_mat('m_bench',     (0.93,0.93,0.93))
make_mat('m_tv',        (0.22,0.23,0.25))

# ---- Cameras from given poses ----
def make_cam(name, pos, look, up, fov_deg=39.6):
    cd = bpy.data.cameras.new(name)
    cam = bpy.data.objects.new(name, cd)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(cam)
    L=Vector(look).normalized(); U=Vector(up).normalized()
    R=L.cross(U).normalized(); U2=R.cross(L).normalized()
    M=Matrix(((R.x,U2.x,-L.x,0),(R.y,U2.y,-L.y,0),(R.z,U2.z,-L.z,0),(0,0,0,1)))
    cam.matrix_world=Matrix.Translation(Vector(pos))@M
    cd.angle=math.radians(fov_deg); cd.sensor_fit='HORIZONTAL'
    cd.clip_start=0.1; cd.clip_end=1000.0
    return cam

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

def box(name, loc, scale, mat, bevel=0.0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1.0, location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name
    o.dimensions=(scale[0],scale[1],scale[2])
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    if bevel>0:
        m=o.modifiers.new('bev','BEVEL'); m.width=bevel; m.segments=2
    o.data.materials.append(bpy.data.materials[mat])
    return o

def parent_to(objs, name, loc, yaw):
    root=bpy.data.objects.new(name, None)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(root)
    for o in objs:
        o.parent=root
    T=Matrix.Translation(Vector(loc)); R=Matrix.Rotation(yaw,4,'Z')
    root.matrix_world=T@R
    return root
